questions: Alright! Now that you know all about our awesome running club, let’s see how well you were paying attention! I’ve got a quick, fun quiz for you. Don’t worry, there’s no pressure and it's just for fun. Shall we begin?
How many members are currently part of our running club? Is it A) 50, b) 300, or C) 1000?
How many minutes of running does it take to boost your mood? Is it A) 15 minutes, B) 30 minutes, or C) 1 hour?
True or False: Running strengthens not just your legs, but also your bones and heart.
Regular running can lower your risk of heart disease by up to what percent: 10%, 30%, or 45%?
What’s our club’s most popular activity: sunrise runs, weekend challenges, or scavenger hunt runs?
correct_feedback: You got it! We have about 300 members. You’re off to a running start!
Yes! According to studies at Harvard, 15 minutes is all you need to improve your mood. That’s quicker than waiting in a Starbucks line during rush hour for some coffee.
That’s right. True! Running is a total-body superhero workout.
That’s correct. According to the National Institute of Health, it’s 45%! Your heart’s happy just hearing that.
Right on! Scavenger hunt runs are our fan favorite. Looks like you’re ready to join one.
incorrect_feedback: Aw that's okay. Maybe next time!
It’s actually 300! That one trips people up; don’t worry, you’re still in the race.
Not quite. 15 minutes does the trick. Let’s sprint into the next one!
Almost …the right answer is True! But hey, every great runner stumbles once.
It’s actually 45%! Pretty impressive, right? Your heart’s cheering you on anyway.
Not quite. Scavenger hunt runs take the crown. You’ll have to come see why!
